title: Billi Ko Pyaas Lagi Thi! 🐱 | Janwaron Par Reham | Islamic Cartoon for Kids
description:
Garmi mein ek chhoti billi pyaasi thi... Ali aur Zara ne kya kiya? 🐱💧 Abbu ne bataya janwaron par reham ka sawaab! 🤲

📖 Hadith:
Abu Hurairah (RA) se riwayat hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne bataya: ek shakhs ne pyaase kutte ko paani pilaya, to Allah ne uski qadr ki aur use maaf kar diya. Sahaba ne poocha: "Kya janwaron (par reham) mein bhi hamare liye ajr hai?" Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Har jaandaar par reham karne mein ajr hai."
— Sahih Bukhari 2363, Sahih Muslim 2244 (Sahih)

✅ Janwaron ko paani aur khana do
✅ Har jaandaar par reham karo

Apne bachchon ke saath zaroor dekhein. Roz nayi kahani — Hidayah ko subscribe karein ❤️
